title: Strict transform commutes with flat étale base change under generic-point control
statement: Let $b:X^+=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X)\to X$ be the blowup of a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal [def-nagata-global-blowup], let $Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $v:W\to X$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] (in particular, $v$ may be étale [def-weil-etale-morphism]). Assume that every irreducible component of $Z\times_XW$ has generic point mapping to the generic point of an irreducible component of $Z$ (equivalently, no component of the pullback lies over a proper closed subset of its corresponding component). Write $Z^{\mathrm{st}}\hookrightarrow X^+$ for the strict transform [def-nagata-strict-transform]. Then the canonical flat-base-change identification $X^+\times_XW\simeq\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I\mathcal O_W}(W)$ identifies $Z^{\mathrm{st}}\times_XW$ with the strict transform of $Z\times_XW$ in $X^+\times_XW$; this equality is scheme-theoretic closure of the common inverse image of $Z\setminus V(\mathcal I)$.
